authority_classes.declared: value asserted inside the bytes under inspection (identifiers, labels, producer names, claimed verification)
authority_classes.locally_computed: hash, size, sequence and chain recomputed from bytes in hand; establishes byte consistency only, never provenance or append-only storage
authority_classes.stipulated_synthetic: premise of a synthetic example; usable only in synthetic traces, never satisfies a real requirement
authority_classes.independently_verified: accepted only when a verification receipt, bound to the object hash by a party independent of its producer, names a verifier present in an external registry
authority_classes.unavailable: evidence that does not exist in this repository or session

authority_classes.rule: Any event or evidence entry that claims independently_verified while its verifier is absent from the registry is counted as a rejected claim and treated as declared only.

acyclic_binding_order: 1 reviewed policy bytes; hash recorded externally; policy contains no hash of later artifacts
2 manifest instance referencing policy_id and policy hash (existing stopping_rule, sampling_order and precision_cost_plan_revision fields)
3 explicit paired plan referencing manifest hash
4 canonical settings hash referenced by manifest
5 materialized dispatch order derived from the plan by R04
6 freeze receipt binding 1-5, ceilings and ledger_id; it contains neither its own hash nor any ledger event hash
7 independent verification receipt citing the receipt hash
8 ledger events citing receipt_sha256 and verification receipt id; each event cites only earlier events
freeze_receipt.fail_closed: A null, missing, mismatching or unverified receipt gives preflight_result outcome blocked and plan_terminal blocked_preflight; no dispatch event is legal. A locally generated hash never substitutes for step 7.

ledger.identity: ledger_id from the receipt; one ledger per frozen plan. Events never contain a receipt's own hash recursively.

event_envelope.receipt_sha256: hash of the exact receipt bytes cited
event_envelope.seq: positive integer; contiguous within one ledger across segments
event_envelope.event_utc: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, non-decreasing with seq within the main segment
event_envelope.prev_event_sha256: event_sha256 of the immediately preceding event; null only for seq 1
event_envelope.event_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON of the event without this field (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii false)
event_envelope.persistence: acknowledged | unacknowledged | unverifiable; acknowledged requires storage acknowledgement before any dependent action
event_envelope.attempt_order: positive integer strictly increasing across the ledger, or null
event_envelope.delivery_id: identity of one retained submission or null
event_envelope.evidence_refs: list of {kind, object_id, sha256, size, uri, authority_class}

ordering.authority: seq is the only ordering claim; UTC corroborates and never reorders
integrity_break_conditions: V05 UTC earlier than previous event
ordering.verified_prefix: maximal prefix of the main segment from seq 1 with none of the break conditions; every event at or after the first break is unverified
ordering.unverified_event_effect: bytes stay retained; the event contributes to no inventory and no completion; every slot it references and that lacks a verified eligible closure becomes indeterminate (ineligible and unresolved); a count can only fall, never rise
ordering.local_chain_status: the hash chain is locally_computed: consistency evidence only; it does not show the ledger was append-only or unmodified before the check

segments.recovery: appended after interruption; may only contain recovery_opened, evidence_gap_recorded, stop_recorded, plan_terminal (stopped_hard_failure) , final_audit and submission_quarantined; recovery_opened.last_verified_seq must equal the computed last verified main seq (V21); no reservation, dispatch, resume or retry (V13)

preflight_result.note: first event; outcome ready requires receipt verified by independent authority for real use

payload: gate {bindings_match, model_window_ok, evidence_ok, reservation_covers: all true}
reserved {tokens, time_s, calls} whole-slot worst case
preconditions: slot is next in frozen order
slot is next in frozen order (V07)
persistence acknowledged before the request is sent (write-ahead)
dispatch_recorded.note: carries attempt_id and attempt_order; one dispatch per slot

payload: evidence_missing[] kinds from the 24 required kinds
preconditions: kind dispatched only while that slot is open (V23)
after plan_terminal only kinds unsolicited or redelivery (V17)

payload: cost null always unless a verified price exists
usage_reconciled.note: one charge per distinct attempt_id; deliveries and proven redeliveries never charge again

stop_recorded.note: at most one per plan; first detected stop prevents all later reservation and dispatch

preconditions: no open slot in main segment (V16); a recovery terminal may leave open slots as unresolved gaps

final_audit.note: first event after plan_terminal; fixes operational completion at terminal

audit_revision.note: recomputed inventories after late evidence; appended, never replacing earlier audits or the terminal state

evidence_gap_recorded.note: explicit storage/evidence gap; a gap is never turned into an absent response

transitions: pre -> blocked via preflight_result blocked; blocked -> terminal via plan_terminal blocked_preflight
open -> open via slot cycle: reservation_made, dispatch_recorded, delivery_retained, delivery_interpreted, usage_reconciled, slot_closed
open -> stopped via stop_recorded; stopped -> terminal via plan_terminal (in-flight slot may still close first)
open -> terminal via plan_terminal finished_* when the frozen order is exhausted
terminal accepts only retention and audit events; no reopen, restart or resume
plan_states.terminal_derivation: blocked preflight -> blocked_preflight; else stop causes present -> state of the primary cause (hard_evidence_failure > settings_drift > budget); else all slots closed and every comparison structurally complete and no unresolved/indeterminate slot -> finished_complete; else finished_incomplete. A stop on the last slot keeps the stop state.

preflight: receipt bytes hash and independent verification status
first-slot reservation affordable against verified ceilings
predispatch_each_slot: no stop and no terminal in verified ledger
remaining ceiling covers whole-slot worst case
usage of earlier attempts reconciled or explicitly unknown with stop
postdispatch_each_slot: returned model and settings match frozen values
usage known if required for ceilings

failure_to_cause.hard_evidence_failure: missing or corrupt required evidence, identity conflict, unproved redelivery, unsolicited attempt, storage/isolation loss, unknown usage needed for a ceiling, external interruption, unreconcilable resources
failure_to_cause.settings_drift: manifest/plan/settings/input/model-window difference before or after dispatch
failure_to_cause.budget: whole-slot reservation does not fit, or request budget exhausted

inputs.bytes_relation: derived by comparing SHA256 of response bytes with the earlier delivery of the same attempt_id: identical | conflicting | no_prior | not_applicable
inputs.proof: effective proof; independently_verified without a registered verifier is downgraded to none
inputs.representable: slot_ref and identity tuple match the frozen plan

slot_level.when: slot referenced only by unverified or unacknowledged events

decision_table.stipulated_synthetic_proof: only exercises the positive branch in synthetic traces. A real DELIVERY_ONLY needs independently_verified proof of delivery-only duplication and no second provider execution; the ledger cannot confer it and equal response text never suffices.
decision_table.invalid_input_no_decision: a delivery for an unknown or mismatching slot identity is not representable and is quarantined

ROW.envelope_row: one attempt row in a synthetic-attempt-evidence/1 candidate; legacy_record attached only if unchanged legacy validation accepts, else null
ROW.completion: may enter structural completion only if closure is attempted_eligible

ROW_UNRESOLVED.envelope_row: representable extra row; attempt_selection stays unresolved

DELIVERY_ONLY.envelope_row: none (additional delivery of an existing attempt)
DELIVERY_ONLY.completion: no new attempt and no new charge

DELIVERY_ONLY_UNPROVED.completion: slot unresolved; hard evidence stop; both deliveries retained

QUARANTINE.envelope_row: none; no valid row is manufactured
QUARANTINE.completion: affected slot unresolved when it concerns a planned slot attempt

BUNDLE_NO_ROW.envelope_row: none; bytes and explicit gap retained

never: a manufactured response, replaced bytes, imputed arm, selected attempt or invented interrupted event

validation_rules.note: Checks over a ledger. V02-V06 define integrity breaks and the verified prefix; the others reject an event as illegal (retained, unverified, contributes nothing) or flag a derived-value mismatch. All checks are data predicates, none grants authority.
validation_rules.V01: ledger_id equals the receipt ledger_id and receipt_sha256 equals the hash of the cited receipt bytes; an unverified or null receipt means no dispatch event is legal
validation_rules.V02: seq contiguous from 1 with no gap or duplicate
validation_rules.V03: prev_event_sha256 equals the previous event_sha256 (null only at seq 1)
validation_rules.V04: event_sha256 equals the recomputed canonical hash
validation_rules.V05: event_utc not earlier than the previous event in the main segment
validation_rules.V07: dispatch_recorded and reservation_made name the next slot in the frozen order
validation_rules.V08: no slot is open (reserved, dispatched or delivered but not closed) when a reservation or dispatch begins
validation_rules.V09: dispatch_recorded is preceded by reservation_made for the same slot with all gate fields true
validation_rules.V10: attempt_id is unique per dispatched or unsolicited attempt and attempt_order is strictly increasing across the ledger
validation_rules.V11: delivery_interpreted cites an earlier delivery_retained (lower seq) of the same delivery_id
validation_rules.V12: delivery_retained size and sha256 equal the carried response bytes; payload retained before any interpretation
validation_rules.V13: recovery segment contains only recovery_opened, evidence_gap_recorded, stop_recorded, plan_terminal stopped_hard_failure, final_audit and submission_quarantined
validation_rules.V15: slot_closed.classification equals slot_closure_rule applied to retained events
validation_rules.V16: plan_terminal in the main segment has no open slot
validation_rules.V17: after plan_terminal only submission_quarantined, evidence_gap_recorded, delivery_retained of kind unsolicited or redelivery, final_audit and audit_revision are legal
validation_rules.V18: no reservation_made or dispatch_recorded after stop_recorded
validation_rules.V19: final_audit and audit_revision inventories equal inventories recomputed from the verified events they cite
validation_rules.V21: recovery_opened.last_verified_seq equals the computed last verified main seq
validation_rules.V22: an independently_verified claim whose verifier is absent from the external registry is counted as a rejected claim and downgraded to declared
validation_rules.V23: delivery_retained of kind dispatched only while that slot is open
validation_rules.V24: usage_reconciled at most once per distinct attempt_id
validation_rules.V27: stop_recorded.primary equals the highest-precedence cause listed
validation_rules.V28: usage_known false when usage is needed for a ceiling requires stop_recorded with hard_evidence_failure before the next reservation

slot_closure_rule: attempted_eligible only if the single dispatched attempt has decision ROW, answer_class ok (complete success, no truncation, interruption, exhaustion, error or failed tool call), legacy_valid true, postdispatch checks pass and no extra attempt, conflicting or unproved delivery exists at closure time; unresolved for multiple attempts, unproved/conflicting deliveries, BUNDLE_NO_ROW or an evidence gap; otherwise attempted_ineligible. Later evidence never edits the closure; it is applied by audit_revision.

inventories.retained_attempts: distinct attempt_id from verified dispatch_recorded and delivery_retained kinds dispatched/unsolicited
inventories.deliveries: verified delivery_retained events of every kind
inventories.missing: planned slots referenced by no retained attempt
inventories.unstarted: planned slots without a verified dispatch_recorded that are not indeterminate
inventories.indeterminate: slots referenced by unverified events and lacking a verified eligible closure
inventories.unresolved: indeterminate, closed unresolved, two or more attempts, any attempt without authorized dispatch, unproved or conflicting delivery, dispatched slot unclosed at terminal, recorded evidence gap
inventories.structural_comparisons: comparisons whose two explicitly mapped slots are attempted_eligible and neither unresolved nor indeterminate, at terminal (final_audit) and at head (latest audit)
inventories.unchanged: planned slots and comparison denominators never shrink; no imputation

reservation_usage.before_dispatch: reservation_made records whole-slot worst case and remaining ceiling
reservation_usage.after_response: usage_reconciled once per distinct attempt_id including unsolicited extras
reservation_usage.unknown_usage: usage_known false keeps usage and cost null, cannot satisfy a required ceiling, and requires a stop with hard_evidence_failure (V28)
reservation_usage.redelivery: no second charge without independent usage evidence of a second execution
reservation_usage.overrun: usage above reservation is an unreconciled resource failure, not an authorization to spend

crash_and_interruption: C1 write-ahead: dispatch_recorded persisted and acknowledged and request bytes retained before any request is sent
C2 dispatch persistence unacknowledged or unverifiable at recovery: send cannot be excluded; slot indeterminate; no resume, retry or reinterpretation
C3 acknowledged dispatch with no delivery: BUNDLE_NO_ROW, slot unresolved; no interrupted event is invented; absence is not a declared absent response
C4 any V02-V06 break: suffix unverified; no terminal is claimed unless a recovery segment records one
C5 forked or duplicate sequence: both branches retained; first break governs
C6 recovery may only stop, record gaps, quarantine and terminate with stopped_hard_failure; it cannot reserve, dispatch, close slots or change verified classifications
C7 post-terminal arrivals: retention events and audit revisions only; terminal state and earlier audits are immutable
C8 a response whose attempt cannot be tied to a verified dispatch: retained via submission_quarantined, never a row, slot unresolved at audit

audit.operational_history: events through plan_terminal in the verified prefix are immutable
audit.late_changes: audit_revision n>=1 recomputes inventories from all verified events; completion can only fall; prior audits stay visible
audit.irrecoverable_gaps: reported by evidence_gap_recorded and in audit inventories; never hidden by dropping planned coverage

policy_rule_crosswalk.R08: answer_class ineligible continues order with no stop
policy_rule_crosswalk.R16: unchanged; no count or target chosen

author_check_findings.subject: V20 versus V17
author_check_findings.observation: In the author application a second plan_terminal is reported as V17 (not a legal post-terminal event) and never as V20. V20 is therefore subsumed by V17 for any second terminal, in either segment; a reviewer should decide whether to keep V20 as a redundant statement or delete it. The saved negative that expected V20 was retained as a mismatch, not edited.

author_check_findings.subject: slot-level NONE versus saved seam expectation S-X23
author_check_findings.observation: Saved expectation S-X23 lists decisions [ROW, ROW] while this contract's decision_table.slot_level also yields NONE for the slot referenced only by unverified events. The application output shows [ROW, ROW, NONE]. The inventory expectation (B-N indeterminate) agrees; only the decision list differs. Retained as a mismatch; a reviewer should decide whether NONE is a decision or only an inventory state.
